About Us

Well-managed projects,
from concept to completion.

Founded in 2023, Turnkey Consultancy specialises in Project Management, Contract Administration and Quantity Surveying across the UK. Based in Tynemouth in the North East of England, we support Developers, Architects, Contractors, and Public Sector Organisations to deliver well-managed, high quality construction projects from concept through to completion.

Our team are experienced in all sectors of the construction industry whilst offering significant knowledge and expertise in all areas of the residential sector including purpose built care facilities, commercial to residential conversions, ‘one-off’ luxury residences and listed building works.

Meet the Director

James Turnbull

Director — Turnkey Consultancy

James has over 15 years’ experience of delivering PM, CA and QS services to Clients and Developers across the UK.

Entering the industry as an Architecture student, James quickly realised his skills in Project and Cost Management, becoming a qualified surveyor in 2010. He maintains his keen eye for design and attention to detail and prides himself in projects being completed to a high standard.

Our Process

Concept to completion,
the Turnkey way.

01

Consultation

We discuss your project, your role in it and where you need support — then give you an honest view of how Turnkey can help.

02

Planning

Programme advice, development programming, planning and Building Regulations assistance — with feasibility cost estimates up front.

03

Design

Working alongside your architect and design team, we coordinate the contract, costs and change control as the design develops.

04

Construction

We administer the contract, value the works at interim stages and report costs regularly — so you always know where the project stands.

05

Completion

Practical completion agreed and the final account settled — a clean, documented close to the project.
